theorem.name: causal transcript-fiber entropy transfer
theorem.finite_horizon: target log-language cost is at most source cost plus log2 maximum fiber
theorem.asymptotic: directed port-rate slack is relative fiber entropy
theorem.exact_corollary: bidirectional subexponential port fibers preserve the complete region

sharpness.exponential_clone: M_R(T)=r^T and M_W(T)=w^T attain corner shift (log2 r,log2 w)
sharpness.finite_quotient: one quotient class can hide positive history-fiber entropy
sharpness.sparse_branching: unbounded fibers can still have zero relative entropy
sharpness.burst: limsup cannot be replaced by liminf

disposition: nonadditive leaf-language transfer is controlled by port-specific history-fiber entropy, not state-class size
